extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
Return to the iconic plane of Tarkir for an epic battle between dragons and clans. As powerful dragonstorms spiral Tarkir into chaos and wild dragons darken the skies, the five clans fight alongside their new Spirit Dragons for supremacy over the land. Discover which clan fits your playstyle with Tarkir’s distinct three-color gameplay.
Be among the first to fight dragons with dragons and play Tarkir: Dragonstorm before release day. Attend a Prerelease event starting April 4 and battle for your clan’s supremacy on Tarkir. For Tarkir: Dragonstorm, Prerelease Packs come in five versions—one for each of Tarkir’s clans—allowing you to align with your favorite or try them all across multiple events.


Contents of each Tarkir: Dragonstorm Prerelease Pack:
• 1 Tarkir: Dragonstorm Seeded Booster
• 14 clan-aligned cards including 1 Traditional Foil Rare or Mythic Rare
• 5 Tarkir: Dragonstorm Play Boosters
• Each Play Booster may contain these cards: TDM 1–286, 292–398; SPG 104–113
• 1–4 cards of rarity Rare or higher (2: 26%; 3: 2%; 4: <1%),
• 3–5 Uncommon cards
• 6–9 Common cards
• Traditional Foil Land replaces a Land in 20% of boosters.
• 1 card of any rarity is Traditional Foil
• Foil Borderless Mythic Planeswalker in <% of boosters
• 1 Traditional Foil Rare or Mythic Rare
• 1 clan-aligned deck box
• 1 clan-aligned Spindown die
